defects.evidence: Owned the diagnostics service’s monitoring dashboards uses duty framing, describing what the candidate was in charge of rather than what they changed or built.
accelerating delivery and improving outcomes for downstream teams makes broad claims without stating what improved or by how much.
The increase from 71% to 83% is a 12-percentage-point increase, not a 12% increase.
The Agent Runtime Suite claim of reducing latency from 900 ms to 600 ms represents approximately a 33% reduction, not 50%.
The 5% latency result is buried after a long method list.
The final robotics bullet mixes migration work with hiring and on-call responsibilities.

Standard GRPO generally uses multiple rollouts per prompt to compare relative rewards and form an informative advantage signal. A single rollout usually increases variance or makes that signal uninformative.
Dynamic batching has no other request to combine with in an isolated single-request workload and can leave latency unchanged or increase it.
The Experience entries are not ordered newest-first.
The narrative review found no supporting evidence in the body for Kubernetes or SQL.
